facts.fact: The regulations define the Authority as the Data Protection Authority and the schedules' forms are headed POTRAZ - Data Protection Authority, with the Authority to issue licences within 14 days and keep a register of controllers.

systems.system: Cyber and Data Protection (Licensing of Data Controllers and Appointment of Data Protection Officers) Regulations, 2024
systems.owner: Minister of ICT, Postal and Courier Services
systems.tiers: Tier 1 (50 to 1,000 data subjects), Tier 2 (1,001 to 100,000), Tier 3 (100,001 to 500,000), Tier 4 (over 500,000)
